senses.gloss:
उद्धन् उद्-धन् (उद्-हन्), cl. 2. P. -धन्ति
(Ved. cl. 1. P. -धनति), -धन्तुम्, to raise up,
elevate.

उद्-धत, अस्, आ, अम्, raised, elevated; exceeding,
excessive; haughty, vain, puffed up; excited, intense;
rude, ill-behaved; (अस्), m. a king's wrestler.
—उद्-
धत-मनस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, or उद्धत-मनस्क,
अस्, आ, अम्, high-minded, haughty, proud.
—उद्धत-
मनस्क-त्व, अम्, n. pride, arrogance.
—उद्धतार्-
णव-निस्वन (˚त-अर्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, raising a noise
like the ocean.

उद्-धति, इस्, f. elevation; pride, haughtiness; a
stroke, shaking.
उद्धम उद्-धम. See under उद्-ध्मा.

उद्-धम, अस्, आ, अम्, who or what blows; (अस्),
m. breathing hard, panting; blowing, sounding.

उद्धय उद्-धय, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. धे with
उद्), who or what drinks.
उद्धर उद्-धर, &c. See 2. उद्-धृ.

उद्-धर, अस्, m., N. of a Rakṣas; (अस्, आ, अम्)
= उद्-धुर (?).

उद्-धार, अस्, m. raising, elevating, lifting up;
drawing out, extraction, deliverance, redemption, ex-
trication; taking away; deduction, a part to be set
aside, selected part; a portion, share, a surplus given
by the Hindū law to the eldest son beyond the shares
of the younger ones; the first division of a patrimony;
the sixth part of booty taken in war which belongs
to the prince; debt, especially a debt not bearing
interest, obligation; recovering property; selecting
(a passage), quoting; (आ), f. the plant Cocculus Cor-
difolius; (अम्), n. a fire-place.
—उद्धार-विभाग,
अस्, m. division of shares, partition.

उद्धर्ष 1. उद्-धर्ष, अस्, m. (fr. rt. धृष्
with उद्), courage to undertake a thing.

उद्धर्ष 2. उद्-धर्ष, अस्, m. (fr. rt. हृष् with
उद्), great joy; a festival (especially a religious one).

1. उद्-धर्षण, अस्, आ, अम् (or fr. next ?), animat-
ing, encouraging; (अम्), n. animating, encouraging.

2. उद्-धर्षण, अम्, n. erection of the hair of
the body, occasioned by great pleasure.

उद्धव उद्-धव, अस्, m. (fr. rt. हु with उद्),
a sacrificial fire; a festival, a holiday; N. of a Yādava,
the friend and counsellor of Kṛṣṇa.
—उद्धव-दूत
and उद्धव-सन्देश, अस्, m. title of two poems.
—उद्धव-ब्राह्मण, अस्, m., N. of a copyist.

उद्धस्त उद्-धस्त, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. हस्त and
उद्), extending the hands, raising the hands.

उद्धा 1. उद्-धा, cl. 3. P., Ved. -दधाति,
-धातुम्, to abandon or expose (an infant); to set
up, erect, build up.

उद्-धि, इस्, m., Ved. a particular part of a carriage,
perhaps the part which rests on the axles; an earthen
stand on which the Ukhā rests.
उद्-धित, अस्, आ, अम्, set up, erected.
1. उद्-धान, अस्, आ, अम्, gone up, ascended.

उद्धान 2. उद्धान, अस्, आ, अम् (for उद्-वान्त,
उद्-ध्मात, and उद्-ध्मान?), ejected, vomited;
inflated, corpulent; (अम्), n. ejecting, vomiting; a
fire-place.

उद्धान्त उद्धान्त, अस्, आ, अम् (for उद्-वान्त?),
ejected, vomited; (अस्), m. an elephant out of rut
(from whose temples the juice ceases to flow).

उद्धुर उद्-धुर, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. उद् and धुर्),
freed from a yoke or burden; ceasing from, leaving
off; unrestrained, lively, cheerful; heavy, thick, gross,
firm; high.

उद्धुषण उद्धुषण, a corruption of 2. उद्-
धर्षण, q. v.

उद्धूषण उद्धूषण, अम्, n. horripilation;
also उद्धुषण. See 2. उद्-धर्षण.

उद्धू उद्-धू, cl. 5. P. A. -धूनोति or -धु-
नोति, -नुते, -धवितुम् or -धोतुम्, to rouse up,
shake up, move; to disturb, excite; to shake off,
throw off; to expel.

उद्-धूत, अस्, आ, अम्, shaken off, fallen from or
off; tossed up, scattered above; exalted; high, loud.
—उद्धूत-पाप, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has shaken
off (his) sins.
उद्धूपन उद्-धूपन, अम्, n. fumigating.

उद्धूलय उद्धूलय, nom. P. -धूलयति,
-यितुम्, to powder, sprinkle with dust or powder.
उद्धूषित, अस्, आ, अम्, having the hairs erected.

उद्धृ 1. उद्-धृ, cl. 1. P. A. -धरति, -ते,
-धर्तुम्, to draw out, raise up, make honoured.

उद्धृ 2. उद्-धृ (उद्-हृ), cl. 1. P. A. -ध-
रति, -ते, -धर्तुम्, to draw out, take out, to extri-
cate, deliver; to tear out, pull out, eradicate; to
extend, elevate, raise: Caus. -धारयति, -यितुम्,
to cause to draw out; to raise: Desid. उज्-जिहीर्षति,
to wish to elevate or draw out, to elevate.

उद्-धरण, अम्, n. the act of drawing out, taking
out, tearing out; taking off (clothes); extricating, de-
livering, rescuing; raising, lifting; eradication; ex-
termination; act of destroying; taking a part or
share; taking from the Gārhapatya fire to supply the
other sacred fires; vomiting, bringing up; vomited
food; final emancipation; (अस्), m., N. of the father
of king Śantanu, the author of a commentary on a
portion of the Mārkaṇḍeya-Purāṇa.

उद्-धारण, अम्, n. raising, elevating; drawing
out of (a danger), delivering; sharing, dividing.

उद्-धरणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be raised or taken
up, to be extracted.
उद्-धर्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be drawn out.

उद्-धारक, अस्, आ, अम्, who or what raises or
lifts, drawing out.

उद्-धारित, अस्, आ, अम्, taken out, drawn forth,
extricated, released.

उद्-धृत, अस्, आ, अम्, drawn up or out as water
from a well &c., raised, elevated; lifted up, thrown
up or upwards; extracted, pulled up or out, eradicated
or broken off; separated, set apart; divided, parti-
tioned; selected, taken from or out of, recovered;
uncovered; dispersed, scattered; holding, containing;
vomited.
—उद्धृत-स्नेह, अस्, आ, अम्, skimmed
(as milk).
—उद्धृतारि (˚त-अरि), इस् इस्, इ, destroy-
ing an enemy.
—उद्धृतोद्धार (˚त-उद्˚), अस्,
आ, अम्, one who has received his share; that from
which a share has been deducted.

उद्-धृति, इस्, f. drawing out; extraction, an ex-
tract; delivering, rescue.
उद्-धृत्य, ind. having raised up or drawn out.

उद्ध्मा उद्-ध्मा, cl. 1. P. -धमति, -ध्मा-
तुम्, to breathe out, to puff, to pant, to blow; to
inflate, to make known by blowing (a trumpet &c.).
उद्-ध्मान, अम्, n. a stove.
उद्-ध्माय, ind. breathing out &c.

उद्ध्य उद्ध्य, अस्, m. (fr. rt. उज्झ्?), a river;
N. of a river.

उद्ध्वंस उद्-ध्वंस, अस्, m. (rt. ध्वंस्),
hoarseness.
उद्-धर्म, अस्, m. an erroneous doctrine, heresy.
